findings.summary: Commands executed working-tree bytes instead of an isolated materialization of the staged candidate.
The whitespace check did not target the staged candidate.
An ignored server .env could affect tests and enter the server Docker context.
The scanner command could contact GHCR when its pinned image was not cached.
The focused runner did not execute an actual rejected public-demo Vite build.
The required append-only Evaluation recorder was absent.
Durable workflow state still selected v2 and did not record the staged implementation or v3 review.
The unchanged-lint-warning requirement had no deterministic comparison authority.

report: The exact v3 hash was verified. The guide traced the approved target, capability, route, and D2 boundaries, but eight Major findings could select different bytes, violate secret/network constraints, omit required evidence, or produce a false PASS. v3 was not executed and is superseded for applicability by the next reviewed revision.
